name: workflow_complete
description: Complete a workflow task in z-camuda with a decision. Use this when the CEO agent (or human via agent) finishes a step in a business process: approves a deployment, accepts a 5-look evaluation score, rejects an opportunity, etc. The task advances to the next node in the BPMN flow (or terminates if it's the last task). The `decision` field is stored as a process variable; the `comment` field is stored in the task's audit log.

decision.description: Outcome of this task. Approved/rejected usually advance/terminate; needs_revision routes back to the previous node.

comment.description: Free-text comment from the approver. Required for rejected/needs_revision, optional for approved. Stored in task history.

variables.description: Optional additional variables to set as part of this task completion. e.g. {"score": 4.2, "weight": 0.25}.
